---
description-meta: "Value of a payment-step lift on all devices against mobile only, the A/B test sizes behind each, and the coupon holdout."
title: "Revenue at stake"
pagetitle: "Revenue at stake"
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {
  loadResults,
  dataAlert,
  testReachChart,
  dataTable,
  formatPercent,
  formatUsd,
  formatCount,
  STEP_LABELS,
} from "./charts.js"

results = loadResults({
  mobileCatchUp: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_mobile_catch_up.csv"),
  paymentTests: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_payment_step.csv"),
  couponHoldout: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_coupon_holdout.csv"),
})
```

```{ojs}
//| classes: data-alert-slot
dataAlert(results.missing)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mobileCatchUp = results.data.mobileCatchUp
paymentTests = results.data.paymentTests
pick = (scope, pace) =>
  paymentTests.find((r) => r.scope === scope && r.traffic_pace === pace && r.test_weeks === 8) ?? {}
allAverage = pick("all devices", "92-day average")
allJanuary = pick("all devices", "January pace")
mobileAverage = pick("mobile only", "92-day average")
perPointShare = mobileAverage.revenue_per_point_usd / allAverage.revenue_per_point_usd
catchUpBest = mobileCatchUp.reduce(
  (best, row) => (row.extra_revenue_usd > (best.extra_revenue_usd ?? -Infinity) ? row : best),
  {},
)
catchUpStep = STEP_LABELS.get(catchUpBest.step_name)?.toLowerCase() ?? "—"
holdout = results.data.couponHoldout[0] ?? {}
holdoutPoints = holdout.holdout_detectable_difference_points?.toFixed(1) ?? "—"
allLift = allAverage.detectable_lift_points?.toFixed(1) ?? "—"
mobileLift = mobileAverage.detectable_lift_points?.toFixed(1) ?? "—"
```

::: {.lede}
Each extra point of shipping-to-payment conversion is worth
${formatUsd(allAverage.revenue_per_point_usd)} per 92 days on all devices and
${formatUsd(mobileAverage.revenue_per_point_usd)} on mobile alone. An 8-week test on all devices
detects a lift of ${allLift} points; on mobile alone it needs ${mobileLift}.
:::

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-revenue
testReachChart(Plot, paymentTests, {
  width,
  weeks: 8,
  title: `An 8-week test on all devices detects a ${allLift}-point lift; on mobile alone it needs ${mobileLift} points`,
  subtitle: `Smallest lift in shipping-to-payment conversion a 50/50 test detects in 8 weeks, at 80% power and a two-sided 5% level. January pace is ${formatPercent(allJanuary.pace_factor)} of the 92-day average traffic.`,
})
```

## Payment step

The value per point assumes that sessions which newly reach payment buy at today's rate and order
value for their device. Mobile alone carries ${formatPercent(perPointShare)} of that value, so a
mobile-only change is worth less per point and takes longer to test. The 92-day average includes
the holiday peak; January's pace is the safer planning figure.

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-table
dataTable({
  caption: "What a 50/50 test of the payment step can detect",
  rows: paymentTests,
  highlight: (row) => row.scope === "all devices" && row.test_weeks === 8,
  columns: [
    { label: "Scope", value: (row) => row.scope },
    { label: "Traffic", value: (row) => row.traffic_pace },
    { label: "Length", value: (row) => `${row.test_weeks} weeks` },
    { label: "Sessions per arm", value: (row) => formatCount(row.sessions_per_arm), numeric: true },
    { label: "Baseline", value: (row) => formatPercent(row.baseline_conversion), numeric: true },
    {
      label: "Detectable lift",
      value: (row) => `${row.detectable_lift_points.toFixed(1)} points`,
      numeric: true,
    },
    { label: "Worth per point", value: (row) => formatUsd(row.revenue_per_point_usd), numeric: true },
  ],
})
```

## Mobile catching up with desktop, at most

This answers the original question: what closing half of the worst mobile gap would add. It
assumes mobile's true deficit at each step is as large as its 95% interval allows. Even then the
largest figure is ${formatUsd(catchUpBest.extra_revenue_usd)} per 92 days, at ${catchUpStep},
which is before checkout.

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-table
dataTable({
  caption: "Half of the largest mobile shortfall each interval allows",
  rows: mobileCatchUp,
  columns: [
    { label: "Step", value: (row) => STEP_LABELS.get(row.step_name) },
    {
      label: "Largest shortfall",
      value: (row) => `${(row.worst_mobile_deficit * 100).toFixed(2)} points`,
      numeric: true,
    },
    {
      label: "Mobile sessions",
      value: (row) => formatCount(row.mobile_sessions_entered),
      numeric: true,
    },
    {
      label: "Buy after step",
      value: (row) => formatPercent(row.purchase_rate_after_step),
      numeric: true,
    },
    { label: "Extra revenue", value: (row) => formatUsd(row.extra_revenue_usd), numeric: true },
  ],
})
```

## Coupon holdout

Confirming the observed coupon difference would need
${formatCount(holdout.buyers_per_arm_for_observed_difference)} first-time buyers per arm, about
${formatCount(Math.round(holdout.days_of_first_time_buyers_needed))} days of buyers at the
sample's pace of ${formatCount(Math.round(holdout.buyers_per_day))} a day, which includes the
holiday peak. A ${formatCount(holdout.holdout_days)}-day holdout detects only differences of
${holdoutPoints} points or more, and less once dilution is counted, because only buyers who would
use a code are affected. It can guard against a large loss of repeat buyers but cannot settle a
small one.
